chapters.title: Prologue
chapters.tagline: Where the water first turns red
chapters.summary: The opening hours on the Leonida coast. A fishing trip, a first taste of freedom, and the partnership that carries the whole story begins here.

chapters.title: Chapter 1 — New Shores
chapters.summary: Settling into Vice City and its sprawl. Learn the systems, meet the first contacts, and start every long collection while the map is still small.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 — Easy Money
chapters.summary: Heists get louder and strangers get stranger. This is the chapter to bank cash, master ranges and races, and clear early stranger strands.

chapters.title: Chapter 3 — Headlines
chapters.tagline: Famous for all the wrong reasons
chapters.summary: The story goes statewide. Airport trouble, televised chaos and mid-game strands all land here, alongside the bulk of vehicle and activity work.

chapters.title: Chapter 4 — Top of the World
chapters.summary: The last full chapter before the endgame. Finish the stranger arcs, rob the hardest targets, and leave almost nothing for the cleanup.
The final mission and the loose ends that only open once the credits are close. Choices made here echo long after the story ends, into everything filed Off The Script.
chapters.tagline: You gotta know when to get off
chapters.title: The Final Ride

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the reward for finishing everything else on the list, so treat it as a victory lap rather than a task. Work chapter by chapter through this guide, keep the missable warnings in view, and the platinum unlocks the moment your fifty-fourth other trophy lands.
steps: Clear every story beat in chapters 0 to 5 in order
Finish all cleanup listed in the epilogue chapter
Open your trophy list and watch the platinum pop last

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The very first mission doubles as your tutorial for movement, driving and the partner system. Take it slowly, follow every on-screen prompt, and do not rush the fishing section because later challenges with Cal build directly on what you learn here.
steps: Start a new game and follow the opening cutscene
Complete the fishing and driving tutorials as prompted
Finish Gone Fishing to close the prologue beat
trophies.tip: Tip: Leave the prologue with full health and a saved game in a second slot; it becomes your clean restart point for any early missable.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every main mission in the first chapter and this pops at the chapter end card. Before you move on, use the newly opened districts to start your vehicle discoveries and activity sampling so the long grinds never pile up at the end.
steps: Complete all Chapter 1 story missions in order
Unlock the first safehouse and save your game
Start two or three side activities before starting Chapter 2

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: The second chapter leans into heists and money, so finish its missions and let the completion trophy land naturally. Spend the chapter payout wisely because several later trophies ask you to spend, launder and invest large amounts across Leonida.
steps: Complete all Chapter 2 story missions in order
Bank your chapter earnings instead of spending them at once
Note which stranger strands opened during this chapter

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter three is the midpoint where the map and the stakes both widen considerably. Clear its missions, then pause for a cleanup sweep of races, vehicles and stranger work while the endgame is still comfortably far away.
steps: Complete all Chapter 3 story missions in order
Do a mid-game cleanup sweep before continuing
Check your activity and collectible counts at the chapter break

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finishing the fourth chapter puts you on the doorstep of the finale, so this is your last relaxed chance to tidy up. After the chapter trophy pops, resist pushing straight into the final missions until your stranger strands and vault robberies are nearly done.
steps: Complete all Chapter 4 story missions in order
Review every remaining silver trophy before the finale
Save in a separate slot at the chapter break

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The closing mission is the point of no return for several story-linked moments, so arrive prepared and keep a manual save from before it starts. Play it in one sitting if you can, make your choices deliberately, and let this gold trophy mark the true end of the story.
steps: Make a manual save before starting the final mission
Stock ammo, armour and snacks for both characters
Complete the final mission and watch the credits
trophies.tip: Tip: Turn off autosave prompts in your head, not in the menu: make the manual save, then commit to the finale without dipping back into free roam.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: An early mission built around trust between the two leads, and a gentle introduction to timed driving under pressure. Learn the route rather than flooring it everywhere, because clean lines beat raw speed on the narrow morning streets.
steps: Accept the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 1
Follow the route markers and keep the vehicle intact
Deliver on time to finish the mission
trophies.tip: Tip: Practise the Breakfast Run route once at cruising speed so the timed attempt feels slower than it really is.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The first full-scale heist of the story and a template for the vault robberies you will do later in free roam. Pay attention to the crew roles and escape staging here, since the same ideas make the optional bank jobs far easier.
steps: Complete the heist setup missions when they appear
Play The Cartel Heist through its escape phase
Escape the wanted level to finish the mission

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A quieter, character-led mission in the middle of chapter two that is easy to rush and miss the point of. Slow down, follow the dialogue cues, and complete every optional conversation beat before triggering the closing scene.
steps: Start Child's Play from the chapter 2 mission marker
Follow the family storyline beats in order
Finish the closing scene to complete the mission

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners throws you into a loud, public set piece where positioning matters more than firepower. Stay in cover during the headline moments, protect your partner when prompted, and push forward only when the crowd and cameras thin out.
steps: Start Headliners in Chapter 3 and watch the intro
Hold cover during the public confrontation
Complete the escape sequence to finish

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: The airport takedown is also your rehearsal for the unscheduled departure trophy tied to VCIA later in this chapter. Learn the terminal layout and vehicle spawns as you go, because you will be back here under very different circumstances.
steps: Infiltrate VCIA as the mission directs
Complete the takedown objectives inside the terminal
Leave the airport area to finish the mission

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A heavy combat mission late in the story that rewards a stocked inventory and patience. Bring your best weapons, use Combat Focus deliberately for clustered enemies, and do not waste the scripted heavy-vehicle section by rushing it.
steps: Prepare loadouts for both characters beforehand
Complete Operation Savage Glory objective by objective
Survive the final push to finish the mission

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: One hundred percent is a checklist marathon covering story, strangers, activities, collectibles and hobbies across the whole state. Use the in-game completion menu as your bible, work category by category in the epilogue, and tick items off in this guide as you confirm each one.
steps: Open the 100 percent checklist in the pause menu
Clear remaining categories one at a time in free roam
Confirm the counter reaches 100 percent

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Two hundred and fifty stunts sounds enormous until you treat stunt jumps as a background habit from chapter one onward. Keep a fast bike or light sports car as your daily driver, clear clusters region by region, and save the final dedicated sweep for this late chapter.
steps: Start logging stunt locations from Chapter 1 onward
Clear stunts region by region rather than randomly
Use a light, fast vehicle for the final sweep to 250
trophies.tip: Tip: Mark stunt clusters on your map with custom waypoints in batches of ten, then clear a batch whenever a story mission drops you nearby.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: A sampler trophy that asks you to touch every activity type at least once, which is exactly how you should learn Leonida anyway. Do one of each as they unlock in chapter one and you will also discover which activities feed other trophies on this list.
steps: Open the activities list in the pause menu
Try each of the 9 activity types once as they unlock
Confirm every type shows at least one attempt

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals across every range challenge reward calm aim far more than twitch speed. Learn each weapon category on its easiest challenge first, memorise target patterns, and only chase gold once the layout feels boringly familiar.
steps: Unlock all shooting range challenges
Practise each weapon category until patterns are memorised
Earn gold in every challenge, one range at a time
trophies.tip: Tip: Lower your aim sensitivity a notch for the precision ranges; gold medals punish overshooting the target more than slow shooting.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Drone races are short, forgiving and best learned one course at a time rather than in a single marathon. Fly the racing line through gates instead of chasing raw speed, and retry immediately while the course is still fresh in your hands.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race start point
Win the race at that location before moving on
Repeat at all 14 locations across Leonida

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty different race wins, not the same easy race twenty times, so variety is the whole point here. Bring a suitably tuned vehicle for each class, learn where rivals brake early, and bank wins steadily from the moment races unlock.
steps: Enter races across different classes and locations
Win each race once and note it before repeating favourites
Reach 20 distinct race wins

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal taught you to fish in the prologue, and now you have to beat him at his own game. Upgrade your tackle when you can, fish the spots he favours in good weather, and be patient on the reel instead of forcing every catch.
steps: Unlock fishing challenges after the prologue
Challenge Cal at one of his fishing spots
Out-catch him to win the challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: The quickest breather on the whole list: find an arcade cabinet, pick the shortest game, and play it to completion. It still counts toward trying every activity type, so pair it with your chapter one sampling run.
steps: Find an arcade with playable cabinets
Choose the shortest arcade game available
Play it through to its completion screen

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand only pays off if you keep returning between story missions instead of leaving it to the end. Do each of his missions as they appear on the map and his final job will unlock well before the finale crowds your schedule.
steps: Meet Andy and complete his first mission
Return for each follow-up mission as it appears
Complete Andy's final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's storyline builds slowly and its final mission is the one players most often leave stranded. Keep his strand moving alongside chapter three, and bring a boat you trust for the closing job on the water.
steps: Start Kenton's strand when his marker appears
Complete each Kenton mission in sequence
Finish his final mission on the water

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy rides alone and expects you to keep up, so a decent bike and some riding practice make his strand far smoother. Clear his missions during chapter two while his territory is still your daily stomping ground.
steps: Meet Billy and accept his first job
Complete his strand missions in order
Finish Billy's final ride alongside him

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight full stranger strands is the real social backbone of the platinum, and it cannot be rushed at the end. Treat every question-mark marker as a story beat in its own right, finish strands fully rather than sampling them, and this silver lands on its own.
steps: Start every stranger strand you encounter
Finish strands completely instead of sampling them
Complete 8 full strands across Leonida
trophies.tip: Tip: Keep a handwritten strand tally on paper; eight finished strands sneaks up on you, and half-finished strands are the real time sink.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's supply business escalates with every delivery, and his final mission assumes you know the routes by heart. Learn the shortcuts during his early jobs and the finale becomes a victory lap instead of a scramble.
steps: Begin Randy's strand and learn his delivery routes
Complete each supply mission as it unlocks
Finish Randy's final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is pure Vice City flavour with a finale that rewards showing up prepared. Keep his missions in your rotation through chapter four and bring a fast, durable car for the last job.
steps: Meet Tyrone and complete his opening mission
Work through his strand between story beats
Complete Tyrone's final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eighteen meditation spots hide in the prettiest corners of the state, and most sit near other collectibles worth grabbing in the same trip. Clear them region by region during chapter two downtime and the trophy quietly completes itself.
steps: Find a meditation spot and interact with it
Work through spots region by region
Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's unique animal is a one-animal hunt that punishes loud approaches, so go in quiet and prepared. Track it at the suggested time of day, line up a clean shot, and deliver exactly what Bret asked for.
steps: Accept Bret's hunting request
Track the unique animal at its habitat
Hunt it cleanly and return to Bret

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards come in themed sets, and completing any three full sets is far smarter than scattering effort across all of them. Pick the three sets whose locations overlap your usual routes and focus until each deck is finished.
steps: Choose three card sets to focus on first
Collect every card in those sets, region by region
Complete all 3 sets in your collection menu

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: One hundred WAiNK locations is a pure exploration grind that pairs perfectly with finishing the map in the finale chapter. Keep the counter visible, sweep district by district, and never pass a marked spot without stopping.
steps: Find your first WAiNK location and note the counter
Sweep locations district by district
Reach 100 WAiNK locations in total

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges accumulate from almost everything you do, so fifty is a milestone rather than a grind if you play broadly. Check the challenge menu near the finale, top up the categories that are one or two completions short, and this pops without drama.
steps: Open the challenges menu and review progress
Top up categories that are nearly complete
Reach 50 completed challenges

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Raise real heat with your partner beside you, then lose it properly rather than waiting it out in a menu. Plan an escape route with alleys and a vehicle swap before you start, and stay together until the stars finally clear.
steps: Commit crimes with your partner present until 4 stars
Break line of sight and swap vehicles if needed
Stay hidden until the wanted level fully clears
trophies.tip: Tip: Tunnels and multi-storey car parks break police sightlines fastest, so plan your four-star escape to end inside one.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shops in a row, one unbroken wanted level, and your partner along for every register. Pick three shops on one straight road, park facing your exit each time, and keep moving before the response escalates beyond driving away.
steps: Choose three shops close together on one route
Rob the first shop with your partner and keep the wanted level
Rob the second and third shops back-to-back without losing the heat

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discovery simply means getting in and driving, so steal broadly instead of loyally driving one favourite car. Airports, docks, rich districts and construction sites each hide models you will never see in normal traffic.
steps: Enter and drive every new vehicle model you spot
Hunt rare models at airports, docks and wealthy districts
Reach 100 distinct discovered vehicles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five takedowns inside one Combat Focus window is about setup, not reflexes. Find a clustered group during an early mission, line up headshots before you trigger the ability, and spend the slow time on targets you already marked.
steps: Find a group of at least five enemies close together
Aim and plan your shot order before activating Combat Focus
Take down 5 enemies before the effect ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: An unscheduled departure means leaving VCIA your own way, in a plane the airport did not plan to lend you. The cleanest window is tied to your business at the airport in this chapter, so attempt it while that access is open instead of forcing it later.
steps: Reach the airfield side of VCIA during chapter 3 access
Take an aircraft without following departure procedures
Leave VCIA airspace in the aircraft
trophies.missable: The easiest access window is during your chapter 3 business at VCIA; forcing entry later is far harder and can lock with story progress.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are military tanks, and the trophy wants you up close with that heat rather than sniping from safety. Wait for a high wanted level or a scripted military encounter, get inside the chaos briefly, and get out before the armour wins.
steps: Trigger a military response or find a scripted Rhino encounter
Engage the Rhino at close range as required
Escape once the trophy registers

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A jewelry robbery with zero detection is a stealth puzzle disguised as a crime. Case the store first, enter when staff sightlines are weakest, move slowly between cases, and leave before anyone understands what happened.
steps: Scout a jewelry store layout and staff positions
Enter quietly and rob the cases without being seen
Exit and leave the area still undetected

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five full bank vault robberies, each ending in a real escape, is the heist endgame of free roam. Use everything The Cartel Heist taught you: stage a fast car, plan two escape routes, and never rob the fifth vault until your loadout is fully stocked.
steps: Rob a bank vault and escape to learn the pattern
Repeat at different banks, varying your escape routes
Complete 5 vault robberies each ending in an escape
trophies.tip: Tip: Rob vaults in ascending difficulty and bank the proceeds between jobs; a bust then costs you time, never your whole bankroll.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks appear in free roam and reward a fast, decisive ambush over a long chase. Block the truck, deal with the doors quickly, grab the take, and be gone before the wanted level grows teeth.
steps: Spot an armored truck in free roam traffic
Stop it and breach the rear doors
Take the money and escape the wanted level

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Exploring all of Leonida means physically visiting every named area, including the quiet rural corners no mission ever visits. Compare your map against the area counter, then plan one long road trip through whatever grey patches remain.
steps: Open the map and note unexplored areas
Drive or fly through each remaining region
Visit all 52 areas of Leonida

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs, nine illegal operations, and one robbery at each is the checklist here. Track which gangs you have already hit in your notes, because the game will not line them up neatly for you near the end.
steps: Identify an illegal operation and its owning gang
Rob it and escape, noting the gang in your tracker
Rob one operation from each of the 9 gangs

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A postcard moment hiding in the opening hours: a cocktail, a view, and Ocean Beach before everything goes wrong. Grab it during your first free moment in the prologue area, because the story soon pulls you far away from this shoreline.
steps: Reach Ocean Beach during your early free roam
Order a cocktail at a beachfront spot with a view
Enjoy the drink while overlooking the ocean
trophies.missable: Tied to the prologue shoreline window; the beachfront spot is easiest to reach before the story moves you inland.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Pick a vehicle showroom with a big glass front, take a car inside, and leave through the window in the grand tradition of the series. Aim for the centre of the glass at speed and the classic-style exit registers cleanly.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a glass storefront
Get into a car inside the showroom
Accelerate and smash out through the glass

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: A deliberately nostalgic detour to the lanes at the Kolt and Associates alley. Play a proper game rather than a single throw, keep your follow-through clean, and enjoy one of the calmest trophies on the list.
steps: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Start a bowling game
Complete your throws with a clean follow-through

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This one celebrates the central partnership at a specific late-story moment with genuine mass appeal. Keep both leads together during the finale beats, follow the prompted interaction fully, and do not skip the scene that follows.
steps: Reach the late-story partnership beat in the finale
Complete the prompted partner interaction in full
Watch the following scene without skipping
trophies.missable: The partnership moment occurs once during the finale sequence; skipping its scene can pass the beat permanently.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Your choices are counted all game long, and the tally runs into the hundreds by the finale if you engage with everything. Talk to people, answer prompts, take optional branches, and the count climbs far faster than story choices alone.
steps: Make optional choices and responses whenever offered
Engage with ambient prompts across the state
Reach the tracked choice count of 500
trophies.missable: Story choices themselves are one-time decisions; a passive playthrough that skips optional choices can finish far below the tally pace.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Some failures in Leonida are scripted luck, and this trophy rewards coming back and succeeding on the second attempt. When an early attempt goes wrong in a way that feels staged, do not reload an old save; try again immediately and take the charm.
steps: Attempt the luck-based early activity and fail once
Retry the same attempt straight away
Succeed on the second try
trophies.missable: Reloading a save after the failed first attempt can reset the sequence; retry in the same session instead.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Leonida hides at least one genuinely strange encounter, and this trophy simply asks you to witness it. Explore remote spots at night, follow odd lights or sounds instead of driving past, and stay until the weirdness fully plays out.
steps: Explore remote locations at night
Investigate strange lights, sounds or sightings
Witness the full strange event

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee swing from a moving vehicle and you have recreated bowling, Vice City style. Drive slowly past a target, time the melee as you pass, and keep the speed low enough that the swing, not the car, does the work.
steps: Equip a melee weapon usable from a vehicle
Drive slowly alongside a target on foot
Land the melee drive-by knockdown

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills only become real money through your contacts, and a quarter of a million is a long but steady pipeline. Feed bills to laundering contacts whenever you hold them instead of stockpiling, and let chapter four earnings do the heavy lifting.
steps: Acquire marked bills from robberies and heists
Deliver them to laundering contacts regularly
Reach $250,000 laundered in total

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spending a hundred thousand across shops is painless if you stop hoarding cash out of habit. Buy weapons, upgrades, clothes and vehicle work as you go from chapter two onward, and keep big purchases for items that also serve other trophies.
steps: Track your lifetime shop spending as you play
Buy useful gear instead of hoarding cash
Reach $100,000 spent across all shops

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Eight garage properties scattered across the state, all far easier to afford once story money stops being spoken for. Buy them in the epilogue in one planned sweep, starting with the districts where your rarest vehicles already live.
steps: Locate all 8 garage properties for sale
Save enough cash from story and cleanup earnings
Purchase every garage property
trophies.tip: Tip: Buy garages in the order you will store rare cars, not the order you discover them, so your best vehicles end up closest to the finale districts.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app turns vehicles you find into registered rides, and ten registrations is an easy chapter one win. Register every keeper vehicle as soon as you park it, rather than trying to remember candidates later.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone
Register a vehicle you want to keep
Register 10 vehicles in total
